title: Who Does What Before Dinner?
titleZh: 晚餐前把家事分工確認清楚
source: 原創基礎課程：小綠書 U02 溝通功能改寫
summaryZh: L1 延伸：發現家事分工有誤會時，說清楚誰做什麼、什麼時候做。

learning.objectiveZh: 聽出分工被更正的地方，最後正確重述每個人的工作與時間。

vocabulary.en: To put plates and other things on a table before eating.
To move the trash out of the home.
Plates, bowls and cups used for food.
To confuse one thing with another.
To clean a surface with a cloth.

task.titleZh: 換個條件：七點不行，改成八點
task.setupZh: 你答應飯後洗碗，也要倒垃圾；但七點不能倒垃圾，只能八點。更正時間並互相重述分工。

steps.partner: You can do the dishes and take out the trash tonight.
steps.promptZh: 確認自己負責洗碗和倒垃圾。
steps.sample: So I do the dishes and the trash?

steps.partner: Right. Can you take out the trash at seven?
steps.frame: I can't ... at seven. I can ...
steps.sample: I can't do it at seven. I can take out the trash at eight.

steps.partner: So you do the dishes after dinner and the trash at eight. Right?
steps.promptZh: 確認最後的兩件工作與時間。
steps.frame: Yes. ... after dinner, and ... at eight.
steps.sample: Yes. Dishes after dinner, and trash at eight.

success: 我有說出自己負責洗碗和倒垃圾。
我有主動把七點更正為八點。
最後雙方重述的工作與時間一致。

spokenPractice.titleZh: 更自然地修復分工誤會
spokenPractice.noteZh: 先學會清楚承認誤會與重述分工；較隨意的說法只作選修。

alternatives.clear: Wait, I thought I was washing the dishes.
alternatives.natural: Hang on, I thought I was doing the dishes.
alternatives.guidanceZh: Hang on 表示先停一下釐清，先聽懂語氣。

alternatives.clear: You're right. I mixed that up.
alternatives.guidanceZh: 中性自然的認錯，可主動練用。
偏美式熟人間的隨意說法，不用在正式場合。

drill.setupZh: 先承認誤會，再正確重述最後分工。

turns.speaker: 室友
turns.text: Hang on, I thought I was doing the dishes.

turns.speaker: 你
turns.text: You're right. My mistake. You do the dishes; I'll wipe the counter.

drill.successZh: 回應要先承認誤會，再說清楚最後誰洗碗、誰擦檯面；不要求使用 My bad。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Dinner is almost ready. Can you set the table?
sentences.zh: 晚餐快好了。你可以擺餐具嗎？

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Sure. Do we need to take out the trash too?

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: I can take out the trash at seven.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Okay. I'll wash the dishes after dinner.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Wait, I thought I was washing the dishes.
sentences.zh: 等一下，我以為是我要洗碗。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: You're right. I mixed that up.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: So I do the dishes and the trash?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Yes. I'll cook and wipe the counter.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Got it. Trash at seven, dishes after dinner.
sentences.zh: 了解。七點倒垃圾，飯後洗碗。

questions.explanationZh: 第 5 回合先出現舊分工，之後更正為 B 洗碗。
B 在第 4 與第 10 回合都確認七點倒垃圾。

questions.q: A 說自己搞混了什麼？
questions.explanationZh: A 把誰洗碗的分工搞混了，之後重新確認。
